text:
Type: tall dark wooden shelving tower
Use: storing towels, books, plants and baskets in a narrow space; bathroom, living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: black-brown stained solid wood frame, slatted wooden shelves
Colors: dark black-brown, espresso
Shape: tall narrow open tower with a solid top, four square posts, four shelves with slatted ones at the middle and bottom, open on all sides, slender but strong vertical presence
Feel: warm, grounded, classic, calm
Goes with: white walls, light grey tiles, linen, brass or chrome; farmhouse, classic or traditional rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: The open shelves give an easy overview and easy reach.
